the-fool.headline: You can take the first step even without knowing the answer.
the-fool.message: The Fool stands for a blank page, a moment when nothing has been decided yet. If there is something you have been putting off because you are not perfectly ready, today is a good day to begin with a light heart. Everyone starts out with unsteady steps.
the-fool.action: Choose one very small first step for something you have hesitated over, and take it before the day is done.
the-fool.watch: Check whether excitement is making you forget to look at the ground beneath your feet. Optimism and recklessness are not the same thing.

the-magician.headline: The tools you need are already in your hands.
the-magician.message: On the table in front of the Magician lie the wand, the cup, the sword and the pentacle. Rather than looking for something new, decide how to use the talents, connections and time you already have. If a task has stayed in your head for a while, today is a good day to take the first step.
the-magician.action: Pick one task you have put off, write down in a single sentence what you will do, and start for just ten minutes.
the-magician.watch: Notice whether enthusiasm is making you promise more than you deliver. This card's strength lies in actually doing, not in showing.

the-high-priestess.headline: Today, listening teaches you more than speaking.
the-high-priestess.message: The High Priestess stands for what is hidden: intuition and the inner voice. Today it is better to observe the situation quietly than to rush to a conclusion. Beyond the information on the surface, something you already know deep down may come to the surface.
the-high-priestess.action: Make a little quiet time and write down the very first feeling that comes to you right now.
the-high-priestess.watch: Do not guess and judge everything alone. Intuition becomes more accurate when it is paired with checking the facts.

the-empress.headline: Care and nurturing help today's efforts bear fruit.
the-empress.message: The Empress stands for abundance, creativity and warm care. When you spend your energy looking after yourself and those around you, both your heart and your daily life grow richer. Opening your senses and fully enjoying good things is also an important part of today.
the-empress.action: Choose one thing that delights your senses, such as a favorite food, flowers or music, and enjoy it slowly.
the-empress.watch: Be careful not to give so much that you leave yourself drained. Taking care of yourself is part of taking care of others.

the-emperor.headline: Standards and order hold your day steady.
the-emperor.message: The Emperor stands for structure, responsibility and steady leadership. Setting priorities among scattered tasks and drawing clear boundaries will ease your mind today. Making decisions based on principles rather than being swept away by emotions can lead to more reliable outcomes.
the-emperor.action: Put today's tasks in order and finish the most important one first.
the-emperor.watch: Make sure principle does not harden into stubbornness. Leave room to hear out the other person's circumstances.

the-hierophant.headline: There is something to learn from proven methods and good advice.
the-hierophant.message: The Hierophant stands for tradition, teaching and shared commitments. Today it is safer to follow a method that has been tested, or the advice of an experienced person, than to look for a new way. Rules and procedures may actually shorten the road.
the-hierophant.action: Ask someone you respect, or turn to a source you trust, for one piece of advice, and follow it as given.
the-hierophant.watch: Check whether you are following a way simply because others do, and whether it fits your own values.

the-lovers.headline: Where your heart leads can guide today's choice.
the-lovers.message: The Lovers is not only about feelings but about choices that match your values. Today what truly matters to you may come into view in a relationship or a decision. If you check in honestly with your heart, the choice becomes much easier.
the-lovers.action: Consider the options you are weighing and write down which one aligns more closely with "the values I truly want to protect."
the-lovers.watch: Do not blur your choice just to meet other people's expectations. Attraction and the choice that suits you can be different things.

the-chariot.headline: Once you set a direction, your strength gathers in one place.
the-chariot.message: The Chariot stands for the will to bring different forces together and move forward in one direction. Even a situation that has left you feeling torn can gain momentum today once the goal is clear. With focus, you can go farther than usual.
the-chariot.action: Choose just one goal for today and set the rest of your schedule aside.
the-chariot.watch: Do not get so carried away by speed that you lose sight of what is around you. Adjusting your pace is as much a skill as moving forward.

strength.headline: Gentleness is the firmest kind of strength.
strength.message: Strength is not about holding things down but about the courage to calm your fear and guide it. When anger or anxiety rises, you do not have to force it away; calmly acknowledging it may help you find a way forward. Today patience is your greatest weapon.
strength.action: When irritation or worry rises, take three deep breaths and give the feeling a name.
strength.watch: Enduring and suppressing are different things. Release the feelings you have stored up in a safe place.

the-hermit.headline: A path appears in the place where you pause.
the-hermit.message: The Hermit stands for stepping away from the noise to find your own inner light. Today you need time to think alone more than answers from the people around you. Sorting things out quietly can make a complicated matter simple.
the-hermit.action: Stay away from your phone for about thirty minutes and think about what matters most right now.
the-hermit.watch: Do not let rest turn into isolation. A conversation with one person you trust can help.

wheel-of-fortune.headline: Turning points always arrive without warning.
wheel-of-fortune.message: The Wheel of Fortune stands for cycles that keep turning and for new phases. Whether things are good or hard right now, they do not stay as they are, and that is both today's comfort and today's warning. When change comes, look for a way to ride it instead of resisting.
wheel-of-fortune.action: Look at any unexpected change that appears today with the thought, "this might be an opportunity."
wheel-of-fortune.watch: Do not let your guard down in a good stretch, and do not lose heart in a bad one. Either way, it passes.

justice.headline: Judging by the facts lightens the heart.
justice.message: Justice stands for cause and effect, fairness and balance. If you set emotion aside for a moment and see things as they are, what you need to do becomes clear. It is also a good day to sort out contracts, promises and accounts.
justice.action: Check one promise or settlement you have left pending and sort out the details based on the facts.
justice.watch: Check whether you have been reading things only in your own favor. Fairness applies to you as well.

the-hanged-man.headline: When you stand still, a different view appears.
the-hanged-man.message: The Hanged Man stands for stopping on purpose to gain another perspective. If a problem remains unresolved no matter how hard you try, it is better today to set it down for a while and look at it differently. A wait that looks like a loss may bring a deep understanding later.
the-hanged-man.action: Think about a stuck problem from the exact opposite point of view and write down what comes up.
the-hanged-man.watch: Do not let waiting become avoidance. It helps to decide for yourself how long you will rest.

death.headline: An ending can clear the way for the next chapter.
death.message: Death does not mean actual death but the closing of a period. As in the card's scene of dawn on the horizon, if there is something you know you should let go of but have kept holding on to, today is a good day to face those feelings. Regret is natural, and only by passing through it can you move on.
death.action: Choose one habit, object or commitment that no longer suits you and let it go. It does not have to be big.
death.watch: See whether you are holding on to the present just to avoid change. This does not mean cutting off everything in a hurry.

temperance.headline: Finding balance without rushing may be the quickest way forward.
temperance.message: Temperance stands for harmony and patience, for blending different things in the right measure. Today the key is to find the middle ground and adjust your pace rather than go to extremes. Balancing work and rest, words and silence will steady your heart.
temperance.action: Put rest into today's schedule first, then arrange the other tasks around it.
temperance.watch: Check whether, in trying to keep the peace, you have swallowed words that needed to be said.

the-devil.headline: What binds you is looser than you think.
the-devil.message: The Devil stands for being pulled along by attachment, habit and desire, yet the chains in the picture hang loosely. The belief that you cannot get free may be the strongest chain. Today is a good day to look honestly at what is holding you.
the-devil.action: Think of one habit you repeat, and write separately what it gives you and what it takes from you.
the-devil.watch: Do not spend your energy blaming yourself. Simply noticing is already the first step.

the-tower.headline: Upheaval is unsettling, but it exposes a false foundation.
the-tower.message: The Tower stands for sudden change and the unexpected. Even if a plan goes awry today or you face an uncomfortable truth, it may be the process of revealing what was never solid. Once the surprise passes, what you truly needed becomes clearer.
the-tower.action: When something unexpected happens, instead of judging right away, take a breath and look for just "one thing I can change now."
the-tower.watch: Do not make a big decision at the moment your feelings run highest. Looking again a day or two later can change your judgment.

the-star.headline: Hope slowly returns to a weary heart.
the-star.message: The Star stands for recovery and hope that come after a hard time. Even if not everything has been resolved, it is a day when your heart grows a little lighter. Even without rushing, you can move forward bit by bit.
the-star.action: Write down three things you have done well lately or are grateful for.
the-star.watch: Do not just wait for hope; follow it with a small action. Recovery grows stronger when you move.

the-moon.headline: Vague worries can ease when you examine them.
the-moon.message: The Moon stands for uncertainty, vague fear and the shadows of the unconscious. Today what you see is not the whole picture, so your judgment may waver. Rather than jumping to conclusions about uncertain things, it is better to confirm the facts one at a time.
the-moon.action: Take what is weighing on you and divide it into "facts" and "my imagination."
the-moon.watch: Worries at night tend to look bigger than they are. Leave important decisions for the morning.

the-sun.headline: Today, do not hide yourself; let your light show.
the-sun.message: The Sun stands for joy, achievement and clarity. Today your mood brightens and things tend to unfold openly. If there is something you want to say or show, express it honestly.
the-sun.action: Share good news or a word of thanks with one person, face to face.
the-sun.watch: Even when things go well, do not overlook the details that need care. Bright days still need the basics.

judgement.headline: It is time to answer the call from within.
judgement.message: Judgement stands for an inner call to settle the past and step up to a new stage. Rather than dwelling on what has passed, today is for acknowledging what you have already learned and going on. If a resolution you have long put off returns to mind, it may be a sign.
judgement.action: Choose one thing from the past to forgive or to finish, and tell yourself, "This is where it ends."
judgement.watch: Do not spend time judging yourself or others again. Focus on the choices ahead.

the-world.headline: Give yourself credit for reaching this milestone.
the-world.message: The World stands for one process coming to an end and everything coming together in harmony. It may be a moment when your efforts so far bear fruit or reach their close. Only by savoring the completion can the next beginning feel light.
the-world.action: Look back on something you recently finished or achieved and give yourself a short word of praise.
the-world.watch: Do not rush straight on to the next task just because something is over. Rest is part of completion too.

ace-of-swords.headline: Clear thinking cuts through a stuck problem.
ace-of-swords.message: The Ace of Swords stands for clarity of thought, truth and breakthroughs. It is a day when the heart of a tangled situation can come into view all at once. If a new idea or resolve comes to you, write it down right away.
ace-of-swords.action: Write the core of what is troubling you in a single sentence.
ace-of-swords.watch: Even a true statement can hurt if delivered sharply. Choose how you say it as well.

two-of-swords.headline: The longer you delay a decision, the heavier your heart grows.
two-of-swords.message: The Two of Swords stands for a deadlock where you avoid a choice with your eyes covered. If both options weigh on you and you cannot take a single step, what is missing may be information, or it may be courage. Today is a good day to work out which one it is.
two-of-swords.action: Write three pros and cons for each option, and set a deadline for yourself.
two-of-swords.watch: Not deciding is also a decision. If you keep delaying, the chance may pass.

three-of-swords.headline: Acknowledging the pain is the beginning of recovery.
three-of-swords.message: The Three of Swords stands for sorrow, hurt and the pain of parting. If something is aching in your heart, today you do not have to pretend to be fine. Allowing yourself to feel and acknowledge the pain is an important part of healing.
three-of-swords.action: Write down what you feel just as it is, or confide in someone you trust.
three-of-swords.watch: Do not keep replaying the pain over and over. If the feeling is too heavy, seeking professional help is also an option.

four-of-swords.headline: Rest is an important task today.
four-of-swords.message: The Four of Swords stands for rest and recovery after the battle. It is a day when your tired body and mind need time to regroup. If you pause for a while, your next step will be much lighter.
four-of-swords.action: Take one item off today's schedule and get enough sleep or rest quietly.
four-of-swords.watch: Do not feel guilty while you rest. Recovery is also preparation for results.

five-of-swords.headline: Look at what you need to protect, not just at winning.
five-of-swords.message: The Five of Swords stands for the emptiness that remains even after winning a conflict. Today be careful not to lose an important relationship or trust while trying to win an argument. First, think about what outcome you really want.
five-of-swords.action: When opinions clash, look for one point where you can give way.
five-of-swords.watch: Ask yourself whether your tone is aimed at putting the other person down.

six-of-swords.headline: You are moving toward a better place, even if progress is slow.
six-of-swords.message: The Six of Swords stands for a time of transition, quietly leaving a hard situation behind. Not everything has recovered yet, but the direction is clearly improving. Take what you truly need and feel free to set down the burdens you do not.
six-of-swords.action: Decide on just one next step to move away from your current situation, and carry it out.
six-of-swords.watch: The journey may feel long. Do not be impatient; trust the flow.

seven-of-swords.headline: The cleverer the choice, the more honesty is needed to keep it balanced.
seven-of-swords.message: The Seven of Swords stands for strategic avoidance and acting in secret. A detour is sometimes wiser than a head-on clash, but keeping things hidden can become a burden later. Today make your plans, but act within what you can be open about.
seven-of-swords.action: Honestly sort out one thing you have left unsaid or unchecked.
seven-of-swords.watch: A small deception ends up unsettling your own heart the most. If you are hiding something, think about it again.

eight-of-swords.headline: The wall is lower than you think, and the bindings are loose.
eight-of-swords.message: The Eight of Swords stands for feeling trapped by fears of your own making. Even if you feel there is no way out, the blindfold and loose cords are things you can undo yourself. Today, question the thought "I can't" just once.
eight-of-swords.action: Pick one thing you believe you cannot do and find the smallest action you can take right now.
eight-of-swords.watch: Do not see asking for help as weakness. From the outside, the exit may be visible.

nine-of-swords.headline: The worries of the night look different in the morning.
nine-of-swords.message: The Nine of Swords stands for a mind kept awake by anxiety and excessive worry. These may be worries that have swelled larger in your head than in reality. Taking a practical step to ease your worries may help today.
nine-of-swords.action: Write down everything that worries you, and mark only the things you can do something about today.
nine-of-swords.watch: Do not hold it all alone. Simply saying what is on your mind lightens the weight.

ten-of-swords.headline: After the darkest hour, the dawn comes.
ten-of-swords.message: The Ten of Swords stands for the end and the bottom of a situation, yet it also shows the first light on the horizon. Even if everything seems over right now, there is still room to prepare for a new beginning. Today is a good day to let go of what has ended.
ten-of-swords.action: Write down one thing you learned from what you have accepted is over.
ten-of-swords.watch: Rather than struggling to undo what has ended, think about what you will need ahead.

page-of-swords.headline: Curiosity is your guide today.
page-of-swords.message: This card represents curiosity, a desire for new information, and keen observation. Asking questions and exploring what interests you may reveal unexpected clues today. Being open and direct with your questions can help.
page-of-swords.action: Pick one topic you have been curious about, research it for twenty minutes, and note the key points.
page-of-swords.watch: Do not spread or assert what you have learned too hastily. Verify first, then speak.

knight-of-swords.headline: A quick decision needs one more check.
knight-of-swords.message: The Knight of Swords stands for swift action and intellectual ambition. Today you may easily find the drive to push through something you had hesitated over. But as speed builds, you need to check your direction first.
knight-of-swords.action: Before you act, pause and think about "who will be affected."
knight-of-swords.watch: Don't speak so hastily that you lose sight of the other person's feelings. Check whether you have missed any details in your haste.

queen-of-swords.headline: Candor is your greatest source of trust today.
queen-of-swords.message: The Queen of Swords stands for clear judgment unswayed by emotion, and independence. It is a day to speak plainly from the standards you have gained through experience and to hold your boundaries. Speaking directly about what needs to be said can actually make relationships easier.
queen-of-swords.action: Organize an uncomfortable conversation you have put off and say it in calm, specific words.
queen-of-swords.watch: Be careful that your composure does not come across as coldness. A word of consideration lightens the weight of what you say.

king-of-swords.headline: A fair standard keeps your day steady.
king-of-swords.message: The King of Swords stands for logic, intellectual authority and fair judgment. It is a day when separating feelings from facts and applying clear principles can help you reach a sound conclusion. It helps especially before important contracts or decisions.
king-of-swords.action: For something that needs judging, set three criteria and evaluate using only those.
king-of-swords.watch: Do not use being right as a reason to pressure others. People's circumstances are part of the facts too.

ace-of-wands.headline: A single spark sets something new in motion.
ace-of-wands.message: The Ace of Wands stands for new beginnings, creative inspiration and the spark of passion. If you suddenly feel like doing something, do not miss that energy. Today is a good day to turn an idea into real action.
ace-of-wands.action: Jot down the idea that came to you and take one first step before the day ends.
ace-of-wands.watch: Even if the spark is big, do not start many things at once. Focus on one to keep it going.

two-of-wands.headline: From where you stand, picture your next stage.
two-of-wands.message: The Two of Wands stands for building on what you have gained to make a bigger plan. It is a day when you are content with the present yet curious about a wider world. Picturing a concrete vision will make your direction clearer.
two-of-wands.action: Write three lines about who you want to be a year from now, and decide the first step.
two-of-wands.watch: So that you do not spend all your time planning, decide on one thing to carry out today.

three-of-wands.headline: Trust that the effort you have put out will come back to you.
three-of-wands.message: The Three of Wands stands for a time of expansion, watching expectantly for the results of work you have sent out into the distance. What you have already begun may be slowly bearing fruit. Rather than being impatient, it is better to prepare for the next expansion.
three-of-wands.action: Check the status of something in progress and make one preparation needed for the next step.
three-of-wands.watch: Do not worry because results are late. If there is something to confirm, reach out first.

four-of-wands.headline: Do not miss a moment to rejoice together.
four-of-wands.message: The Four of Wands stands for the sense of achievement that comes from finishing an important stage, and for the joy of a stable community. It is a good day to share good things with those close to you. Recognizing and celebrating your achievements can give you energy for what comes next.
four-of-wands.action: Celebrate a recent small achievement together with someone close.
four-of-wands.watch: Do not settle into comfort and forget to prepare for what is next. After enjoying it, plan one step further.

five-of-wands.headline: Clashing opinions may be part of something bigger taking shape.
five-of-wands.message: The Five of Wands stands for competition and chaotic energy where many opinions tangle. It may be more about testing each other's ideas than a genuine conflict. Speak your mind, but work toward common ground without disrupting the group.
five-of-wands.action: In a meeting or conversation, first sum up the core of the other person's opinion in one sentence.
five-of-wands.watch: Do not let the wish to win turn into an emotional quarrel. Do not waste energy on small matters.

six-of-wands.headline: Accept recognition for your efforts with confidence.
six-of-wands.message: The Six of Wands stands for the fruit of effort and recognition from those around you. Today your results may become visible, or you may receive praise. Be modest, but do not belittle yourself; accept the joy.
six-of-wands.action: Review what you have recently accomplished and, if it feels right, share it with those around you.
six-of-wands.watch: Do not depend too much on being recognized. Even without applause, what you have done does not disappear.

seven-of-wands.headline: If there is something you want to protect, do not back down.
seven-of-wands.message: The Seven of Wands stands for standing on high ground and facing challenges and pressure from many directions. Today a situation may arise in which you must clearly hold your position. Rather than trying to block everything, focus on protecting what matters most.
seven-of-wands.action: Decide on one core principle to uphold, and be firm only about that.
seven-of-wands.watch: If you take every criticism as an attack, you will wear out. Be selective about the advice you listen to.

eight-of-wands.headline: What was stuck begins to move quickly.
eight-of-wands.message: The Eight of Wands stands for a flow in which delays end and things move fast. It is a day when news may arrive and messages, travel and progress pick up. When the flow comes, the important thing is not to miss the timing.
eight-of-wands.action: Sort out the messages or replies you have put off and send them today.
eight-of-wands.watch: As things speed up, mistakes can increase too. Check once more before you send.

nine-of-wands.headline: Even tired, you still have strength for the last stretch.
nine-of-wands.message: The Nine of Wands stands for perseverance that does not give up after many hardships. Even if you feel exhausted in body and mind, you have already come a long way. Today, balance staying alert with giving yourself time to recover.
nine-of-wands.action: Admit which part of you is most tired, and plan today so that you save your energy.
nine-of-wands.watch: Do not distrust everyone because of old wounds. You may ask for help from those you can trust.

ten-of-wands.headline: Find a way to share the load you carry alone.
ten-of-wands.message: The Ten of Wands stands for being overloaded, shouldering too much responsibility alone. The destination may look close, yet you may be worn out in body and mind. Today is for looking at what you can put down or share.
ten-of-wands.action: Choose one item on your to-do list that you can hand off or put off, and sort it out.
ten-of-wands.watch: The thought that everything is yours to do makes the load grow. Asking for help is also a form of responsibility.

page-of-wands.headline: Curiosity lights the fire for something new.
page-of-wands.message: This card stands for the youthful energy to explore something new with passion and curiosity. You may lack experience, but it is a day full of excitement and ideas. Trying something small can bring unexpected fun and clues.
page-of-wands.action: Spend just fifteen minutes trying something new you have wanted to do but kept putting off.
page-of-wands.watch: Interest can fade quickly, so aim not to see it through to the end but simply to try it once.

knight-of-wands.headline: A bold move changes the atmosphere.
knight-of-wands.message: The Knight of Wands stands for adventure, fiery passion and swift drive. Today your energy is higher than usual, so a bold action can lead to a good result. Just set a direction so that passion does not turn into impulse.
knight-of-wands.action: Spend an hour focusing on whatever excites you most.
knight-of-wands.watch: Do not get so caught up in starting that you forget to follow through. Make only the promises you can keep.

queen-of-wands.headline: Confidence brightens everyone around you.
queen-of-wands.message: The Queen of Wands stands for confidence, warm charisma and lively independence. Today, showing your true self with confidence may help things go more smoothly. Your confidence also gives courage to the people around you.
queen-of-wands.action: Say the thing you want to say or propose today directly, without hesitation.
queen-of-wands.watch: So that your confidence does not overwhelm others, watch how they respond too.

king-of-wands.headline: Speak your vision and lead those who will go with you.
king-of-wands.message: The King of Wands stands for leadership with charisma refined by experience and a clear vision. It is a good day to share the big picture and inspire others to act. A concrete plan can help turn your passion into reality.
king-of-wands.action: State the goal of your current work in one sentence and share it with the people you work with.
king-of-wands.watch: Do not run ahead alone. Check the pace of those who go with you.

ace-of-cups.headline: Do not miss the moment your heart opens.
ace-of-cups.message: The Ace of Cups stands for the beginning of new emotions, love, and a fresh flow of inspiration. Today you may meet something or someone who warms your heart. Do not hold your feelings back; let yourself feel them as they are.
ace-of-cups.action: Write in one line a feeling that touches you now, or something you are grateful for.
ace-of-cups.watch: Do not jump to a conclusion just because your emotions are overflowing. Let feeling and deciding unfold slowly.

two-of-cups.headline: Relationships deepen when feelings are shared.
two-of-cups.message: The Two of Cups stands for mutual love and harmonious partnership. It is a good day to understand each other and find balance in a relationship. Trust can grow stronger not only with a partner but with colleagues and friends.
two-of-cups.action: Tell someone close to you that you are thankful, in one specific sentence.
two-of-cups.watch: Do not let yourself be the only one making compromises. Make sure to express your own feelings too.

three-of-cups.headline: Time spent together is what gives you energy today.
three-of-cups.message: The Three of Cups stands for friendship, community and the joy of being together. Laughing and talking with people who matter to you lightens the heart. Even work that needs cooperation goes smoothly in an atmosphere of helping one another.
three-of-cups.action: Send a short hello to a friend or colleague you have not been in touch with for a long time.
three-of-cups.watch: Do not put off tasks or responsibilities because you are caught up in the fun. Even socializing needs balance.

four-of-cups.headline: Check whether an opportunity in front of you has slipped by.
four-of-cups.message: The Four of Cups stands for a state of boredom and indifference in which you cannot see the possibilities around you. When what you have feels dull, a new offer may quietly come toward you. Today, open your heart a little and look around again.
four-of-cups.action: Check again whether there is a recent offer or message you passed over without noticing.
four-of-cups.watch: Try to tell where your present dissatisfaction comes from. It may not be that everything is bad.

five-of-cups.headline: Beside what you lost, something still remains.
five-of-cups.message: The Five of Cups stands for focusing on loss and regret so that you cannot see what is left. Sadness is natural, but if you turn your gaze just a little, two cups are still standing. Today, acknowledge the disappointment and look at what remains too.
five-of-cups.action: Write side by side one thing you lost and one thing you still have.
five-of-cups.watch: Dwelling on regret for too long blocks your view ahead. Acknowledge your sadness fully, but gradually turn your eyes to your daily life too.

six-of-cups.headline: Warm memories become today's strength.
six-of-cups.message: The Six of Cups stands for nostalgia, pure joy and the warmth of memory. An old friend, place or memory may comfort your heart today. Try bringing that warmth into your present relationships and daily life.
six-of-cups.action: Find one photo or song that brings back a happy memory.
six-of-cups.watch: Do not stay in the thought that the past was better and miss the present.

seven-of-cups.headline: The more choices you have, the more you need a standard.
seven-of-cups.message: The Seven of Cups stands for a state in which illusion and reality mix before many possibilities. Much attracts you, but you need to tell which things you can actually achieve. Today, reduce the fantasy and check what is realistic.
seven-of-cups.action: List the options that come to mind, and mark whether each has "a real action I can take today."
seven-of-cups.watch: If you try to hold every option, it is hard to achieve even one. Set your priorities.

eight-of-cups.headline: Leaving is not giving up; it is going to a deeper place.
eight-of-cups.message: The Eight of Cups stands for the decision to leave and search for new meaning when the heart is not filled even though everything seems enough. Today is a day to reflect on whether where you are now suits you. Once you know what is lacking, the direction also appears.
eight-of-cups.action: Write down one thing that is "not being filled" in your current work or relationship.
eight-of-cups.watch: Do not leave on impulse when your emotions are running high. Move after you have sorted out your heart well.

nine-of-cups.headline: It is a day when a wish fulfilled can bring satisfaction.
nine-of-cups.message: The Nine of Cups is called the wish card and stands for the contentment of a wish granted and emotional abundance. Today is a good day to fully enjoy what you have and feel joy. When you acknowledge what has come true, your next wish also becomes clear.
nine-of-cups.action: Say a word of thanks to yourself for something that recently came true.
nine-of-cups.watch: Do not linger in satisfaction and miss your next goal. Enjoying and stopping are not the same.

ten-of-cups.headline: Peace with the people you love is today's treasure.
ten-of-cups.message: The Ten of Cups stands for emotional fulfillment with family and loved ones. Today is a good day to feel that daily life with those beside you is the greatest happiness. Even if it is not perfect, there are moments that are warm enough.
ten-of-cups.action: Sit down with someone close and talk for even ten minutes today.
ten-of-cups.watch: Do not compare the present with an ideal picture. See the warmth just as it is.

page-of-cups.headline: Listen to the small message that rises in your heart.
page-of-cups.message: This card stands for the youthful energy of sensitivity and creativity, and for intuitive messages. News or an idea that touches your heart may come from an unexpected place. If you express your feelings lightly, a path opens.
page-of-cups.action: Jot down any idea or dreamlike image that suddenly comes to mind.
page-of-cups.watch: Your emotions can sway easily, so do not make a big promise based on mood alone.

knight-of-cups.headline: A sincere offer moves hearts.
knight-of-cups.message: The Knight of Cups stands for romance, an emotional invitation and artistic expression. Today brings a flow in which good news may come or it is a good time to share your heart. A gentle attitude of moving slowly toward your ideals helps.
knight-of-cups.action: Try writing the sincere feeling you wanted to convey as a letter or message.
knight-of-cups.watch: Do not get swept up in the mood and skip practical checks. Make your words and actions match.

queen-of-cups.headline: Deep empathy is your strength today.
queen-of-cups.message: The Queen of Cups stands for emotional maturity, deep empathy and intuitive wisdom. It is a day when you can understand others' feelings well and also take care of your own heart. Listening to someone can itself be healing.
queen-of-cups.action: Instead of offering solutions to someone who seems to be struggling, listen closely to their story.
queen-of-cups.watch: Do not take on other people's feelings. Keep the boundaries of your own heart, and you can stay empathetic for a long time.

king-of-cups.headline: Keep your center even on the waves of emotion.
king-of-cups.message: The King of Cups stands for a mature balance, mastering emotion without losing warmth. Today is a good day to stay calm and centered even when things get heated or shaky. Do not suppress your feelings, but handle them together with reason.
king-of-cups.action: When emotions rise, pause for a moment before reacting, steady your breath, and then speak.
king-of-cups.watch: Hiding feelings and mastering them are different. Express the feelings that need expressing.

ace-of-pentacles.headline: It is time to grow the opportunity in your hand into reality.
ace-of-pentacles.message: The Ace of Pentacles stands for a new opportunity that leads to concrete results and the start of stability. Today a practical seed may be given in finances, work or health. Make a realistic plan, even a small one.
ace-of-pentacles.action: Choose one opportunity you want to grow now, and write down the resources and first step it needs.
ace-of-pentacles.watch: Do not spend large sums of money or time without checking just because you are excited that a chance has come.

two-of-pentacles.headline: Balance flexibly, and it is all right to wobble.
two-of-pentacles.message: The Two of Pentacles stands for the adaptability to keep balance among many tasks and responsibilities. Even if your tasks overlap today, you can get through without strain if you find your rhythm. Set your priorities and adjust flexibly.
two-of-pentacles.action: Pick one thing on today's list that can wait, and make your schedule lighter.
two-of-pentacles.watch: Do not try to juggle everything at once. If you see signs of losing balance, cut back.

three-of-pentacles.headline: When each person's skills come together, the result is good.
three-of-pentacles.message: The Three of Pentacles stands for skill, cooperation and the craftsmanship of making something together. Today results improve when you share roles with people who have expertise rather than working alone. Recognition and feedback become the ground for growth.
three-of-pentacles.action: Clearly ask one person for help with the part of your work where you need it.
three-of-pentacles.watch: Do not insist on only your own way. Try reflecting other people's opinions too.

four-of-pentacles.headline: Loosen a tightly clenched hand a little, and things begin to flow.
four-of-pentacles.message: The Four of Pentacles stands for a state in which the wish to keep stability turns into clinging. Today is for looking at whether fear of losing what you have is blocking change. Management matters, but too much of it stops growth.
four-of-pentacles.action: Choose one thing you are holding on to that is fine to let go of, and sort it out.
four-of-pentacles.watch: Saving and being stingy are different. Spend appropriately where it is needed.

five-of-pentacles.headline: Help is closer than you think.
five-of-pentacles.message: The Five of Pentacles stands for lack, hardship and loneliness, yet in the picture there is a lit window. A heavy heart may cloud your eyes and make you miss the help nearby. Today is for reaching out first.
five-of-pentacles.action: Honestly tell one person you trust about your present situation.
five-of-pentacles.watch: The thought that you must bear it alone makes things harder. Asking for help is not weakness.

six-of-pentacles.headline: The balance of giving and receiving is today's key.
six-of-pentacles.message: The Six of Pentacles stands for generosity and fair sharing. Today a flow of sharing what you can give, or accepting what you need, arises naturally. Whether you are the giver or the receiver, balance of heart is what matters.
six-of-pentacles.action: Offer one person something you can share, whether time, knowledge or care.
six-of-pentacles.watch: Do not let giving come with strings attached. Receive with gratitude, too.

seven-of-pentacles.headline: In the waiting, review the effort you have made so far.
seven-of-pentacles.message: The Seven of Pentacles stands for a patient time of evaluating results after long effort. Even if results are not visible yet, what you have been growing steadily is on its way. Today is a good day to check whether your direction so far is right.
seven-of-pentacles.action: Gather the traces of the effort you have built up and decide one thing to adjust going forward.
seven-of-pentacles.watch: Do not give up easily because results are slow. But if the direction is wrong, correction is needed.

eight-of-pentacles.headline: Steady repetition builds skill.
eight-of-pentacles.message: The Eight of Pentacles stands for steady practice and the focus of a craftsman honing a skill. Today, work built up faithfully even if unnoticed carries great value. Try to immerse yourself deeply in one thing.
eight-of-pentacles.action: Set aside thirty minutes for one skill you want to learn and focus without interruption.
eight-of-pentacles.watch: Do not delay starting out of attachment to perfection. Repetition raises quality.

nine-of-pentacles.headline: You may fully enjoy the abundance you built yourself.
nine-of-pentacles.message: The Nine of Pentacles stands for independence and material stability earned through effort. Today even time alone can be pleasant and relaxed. Proudly acknowledge what you have made.
nine-of-pentacles.action: Give yourself a small reward or a gift of leisure time.
nine-of-pentacles.watch: Do not let the feeling that you are fine alone become a reason to close yourself off from others.

ten-of-pentacles.headline: Look at the foundation of a stability that will last.
ten-of-pentacles.message: The Ten of Pentacles stands for family, legacy, and abundance and stability that last a long time. Today is a good day to review matters of long-term finances, family or home. What lasts matters more than what is right before your eyes.
ten-of-pentacles.action: Talk about one long-term plan with family or someone you will be with for a long time.
ten-of-pentacles.watch: Do not focus so much on keeping stability that you miss the joy of the present.

page-of-pentacles.headline: A small lesson becomes a solid beginning.
page-of-pentacles.message: This card stands for the attitude of learning new skills and building realistic goals one step at a time. Today things go well if you break your plan into concrete pieces and begin. A willingness to learn without hurrying becomes your strength.
page-of-pentacles.action: Find one resource or course for something you want to learn and read the first page.
page-of-pentacles.watch: Do not only accumulate theory; try doing it yourself, even in a small way. Experience completes learning.

knight-of-pentacles.headline: Steadiness is the most trustworthy speed.
knight-of-pentacles.message: The Knight of Pentacles stands for the trust and diligence of getting things done slowly but surely. Today finishing what is yours step by step brings better results than one striking move. It is a day when responsibility is recognized.
knight-of-pentacles.action: Finish today's tasks one by one and mark each as done.
knight-of-pentacles.watch: Do not let caution become a refusal of change. If needed, try changing your method.

queen-of-pentacles.headline: The strength to care warmly for reality is today's wisdom.
queen-of-pentacles.message: The Queen of Pentacles stands for practical wisdom, warm care and the ability to create an abundant environment. Today, putting the basics of daily life in order, such as home, work and health, steadies the heart as well. A thrifty and kind attitude helps.
queen-of-pentacles.action: Tidy or tend to one uncomfortable spot in your everyday space.
queen-of-pentacles.watch: Do not let all the caring become your responsibility. You also deserve to be cared for.

king-of-pentacles.headline: What you have built with a long view becomes trust.
king-of-pentacles.message: The King of Pentacles stands for stable leadership, excellent practical sense and material success. Today, deciding on finances, business or work with a long-term view brings reliable results. An attitude of managing with room to spare is important.
king-of-pentacles.action: Put the state of your finances or work into numbers, and make a plan for the next three months.
king-of-pentacles.watch: Do not value only achievements and possessions. See the value of people and time as well.
